# ============================================================================
# Unit Test CMakeLists.txt
# Auto-generated by Template Engine
# ============================================================================

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(theSpeaker (3 boards)_tests C CXX)

# Use mock implementations for HAL
add_compile_definitions(HAL_USE_MOCK=1)
add_compile_definitions(HAL_PLATFORM_MOCK=1)

# Enable testing
enable_testing()

# ============================================================================
# Unity Test Framework
# ============================================================================

# Option 1: Use FetchContent to download Unity
include(FetchContent)
FetchContent_Declare(
    unity
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/ThrowTheSwitch/Unity.git
    GIT_TAG        v2.5.2
)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(unity)

# Option 2: If Unity is already installed locally
# find_package(Unity REQUIRED)

# ============================================================================
# Source Files
# ============================================================================

# Production code under test
set(SRC_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../main)

set(PRODUCTION_SOURCES
)

# HAL Mock implementations
set(HAL_MOCK_SOURCES
    ${SRC_DIR}/hal/hal_gpio_mock.c
)

# Test source files
set(TEST_SOURCES
    test_main.c
    test_hal_gpio.c
    test_ili9341_tft_display.c
    test_xpt2046_touch_controller.c
    test_rgb_led.c
    test_ldr_light_sensor.c
    test_microsd_card_slot.c
    test_speaker_connector_8002a_amp.c
    test_bluetooth_speaker.c
)

# OSAL Mock (if used)
set(OSAL_MOCK_SOURCES
    mocks/osal_mock.c
)

# ============================================================================
# Include Directories
# ============================================================================

set(INCLUDE_DIRS
    ${SRC_DIR}
    ${SRC_DIR}/hal
    ${SRC_DIR}/osal
    ${SRC_DIR}/middleware
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/mocks
)

# ============================================================================
# Test Executable
# ============================================================================

add_executable(${PROJECT_NAME}
    ${TEST_SOURCES}
    ${PRODUCTION_SOURCES}
    ${HAL_MOCK_SOURCES}
    ${OSAL_MOCK_SOURCES}
)

target_include_directories(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE ${INCLUDE_DIRS})

target_link_libraries(${PROJECT_NAME}
    unity
)

# C/C++ standards
set_target_properties(${PROJECT_NAME} PROPERTIES
    C_STANDARD 11
    CXX_STANDARD 17
)

# Enable warnings
target_compile_options(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
    -Wall
    -Wextra
    -Wpedantic
)

# ============================================================================
# Test Registration
# ============================================================================

add_test(NAME unit_tests COMMAND ${PROJECT_NAME})

# Individual test targets for convenience
add_test(NAME test_ili9341_tft_display 
         COMMAND ${PROJECT_NAME} -n test_ili9341_tft_display_*)
add_test(NAME test_xpt2046_touch_controller 
         COMMAND ${PROJECT_NAME} -n test_xpt2046_touch_controller_*)
add_test(NAME test_rgb_led 
         COMMAND ${PROJECT_NAME} -n test_rgb_led_*)
add_test(NAME test_ldr_light_sensor 
         COMMAND ${PROJECT_NAME} -n test_ldr_light_sensor_*)
add_test(NAME test_microsd_card_slot 
         COMMAND ${PROJECT_NAME} -n test_microsd_card_slot_*)
add_test(NAME test_speaker_connector_8002a_amp 
         COMMAND ${PROJECT_NAME} -n test_speaker_connector_8002a_amp_*)
add_test(NAME test_bluetooth_speaker 
         COMMAND ${PROJECT_NAME} -n test_bluetooth_speaker_*)

# ============================================================================
# Coverage (optional)
# ============================================================================

option(ENABLE_COVERAGE "Enable code coverage" OFF)

if(ENABLE_COVERAGE)
    target_compile_options(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE --coverage -fprofile-arcs -ftest-coverage)
    target_link_options(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE --coverage)
    
    # Coverage report target
    add_custom_target(coverage
        COMMAND ${PROJECT_NAME}
        COMMAND lcov --capture --directory . --output-file coverage.info
        COMMAND lcov --remove coverage.info '/usr/*' '*/test/*' '*/unity/*' --output-file coverage_filtered.info
        COMMAND genhtml coverage_filtered.info --output-directory coverage_report
        WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}
        COMMENT "Generating code coverage report..."
    )
endif()

# ============================================================================
# Run Tests Target
# ============================================================================

add_custom_target(run_tests
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_CTEST_COMMAND} --output-on-failure
    DEPENDS ${PROJECT_NAME}
    WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}
    COMMENT "Running unit tests..."
)

# ============================================================================
# Verbose Test Output
# ============================================================================

add_custom_target(run_tests_verbose
    COMMAND ${PROJECT_NAME}
    DEPENDS ${PROJECT_NAME}
    WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}
    COMMENT "Running unit tests (verbose)..."
)
